scope: The unchanged released Byron genesis reader as readGenesisData applies it: parseCanonicalJSON of the bytes, the genesis hash (hashRaw of renderCanonicalJSON), then fromJSField of nonAvvmBalances (GenesisNonAvvmBalances) and avvmDistr (GenesisAvvmBalances), and UTxO.fromBalances of each, the AVVM balances at redeem addresses without a network magic; a genesis object with the two balance fields and, for the parser's cases, one field no reader looks up; no other genesis field, ledger rule or signature is run

genesisData.note: FromJSON GenesisData reads nonAvvmBalances and avvmDistr with fromJSField (96, 102); readGenesisData parses with parseCanonicalJSON (169-181)

address.note: FromObjectKey Address is decodeAddressBase58 (188-189): Base58, then decodeFull' byronProtVer (233-243)

lovelace.note: FromJSON Lovelace is fmap Lovelace . fromJSON @Word64, with no maxLovelaceVal check (117-118)

utxo.note: fromBalances keys each output by serializeCborHash of its address (121-131)

genesisUtxo.note: genesisUtxo: the AVVM balances at makeRedeemAddress, then the non-AVVM balances (16-32)

canonicalClass.note: FromJSON (Map k a): Map.fromList of the entries reversed, so the first of two equal keys holds (162-175)

canonicalTypes.note: JSString holds the UTF-8 bytes, fromJSString gives one Char per byte (64, 90-91)

redeemKey.note: fromAvvmVK: - and _ to + and /, base64-bytestring decode, 32 bytes (120-129)

canonicalParse.note: parseCanonicalJSON (117-118): Parsec over the bytes, spaces, strings with the escapes \" and \\ only (178-), Int54 numbers of at most 15 digits (219-), nothing read after the value; renderCanonicalJSON (70-71): keys sorted, no whitespace
